levels.name: Passasjen under sporene (underpass)
levels.note: Bane NOR: the waiting room is in the underpass under the tracks, entered from the passage. Escalators, stairs and lifts go from here up to the platforms. OSM tags the underpass, escalators, stairs and lifts '-1;0'.
levels._source: Bane NOR station page https://www.banenor.no/reise-og-trafikk/stasjoner/-l-/lysaker/, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract NO-LYS), read 2026-10-30

levels.name: Plattformer (elevated)
levels.note: Elevated station with two island platforms: tracks 1/2 and tracks 3/4, each 13 m wide and 700 mm high, 280 m and 266 m long. Askerbanen uses tracks 2 and 3, Drammenbanen tracks 1 and 4.
levels._source: Bane NOR station page https://www.banenor.no/reise-og-trafikk/stasjoner/-l-/lysaker/, read 2026-10-30; en.wikipedia.org 'Lysaker Station' https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lysaker_Station, read 2026-10-30

levels.name: Lysaker torg (OSM level 3)
levels.note: OSM has entrances at levels 0 and 3, all nearest Lysaker torg, and two lifts '0;3' there. No owner source names this level.

amenities.name: Joker Lysaker stasjon
amenities.note: from OSM; compare with the owner list in the hand-read facts

open: Shop positions and 'where': no owner text says where in the passage each shop is. Positions come from OSM, which has no level for the shops.
Hours for Joker, Espresso House, Mett på Lett and Subway are OSM's only; the chains' store finders could not be read. Narvesen and Tintin have no hours.
Level names: Bane NOR says only 'passasjen/undergang under sporene'. OSM level 3 at Lysaker torg is not explained by any owner source.
Entrances: only the Lysaker torg side is in OSM. Bane NOR names Drammensveien (bus, south), Strandveien (taxi, east) and Nordraaks vei 1 (parking) but not the entrance doors.
Fornebubanen construction at Lysaker may change access; not checked.

answers.question: Which platforms have stairs/lifts
answers.answer: Both island platforms (1/2 and 3/4) are reached from the underpass by escalator, stairs and lift (Bane NOR). OSM shows one escalator, one stair and one lift per platform. Which set goes to which platform is not tagged.
answers._source: Bane NOR station page https://www.banenor.no/reise-og-trafikk/stasjoner/-l-/lysaker/, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract NO-LYS), read 2026-10-30
